Select distinct chembl_id from molecule_dictionary, compound_name from compound_records, and canonical_smiles from compound_structures for molecules linked to document CHEMBL1240317. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (inner join to enforce canonical_smiles availability). Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
